name: cypr2026-pages
description: Cypr 2026 — statyczny plan podróży wdrażany na Cloudflare Pages

scripts.preview: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.project:create: npx wrangler pages project create cypr2026 --production-branch gh-pages --force
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name cypr2026 --branch gh-pages --commit-dirty=true
